summary: Energy Fuels Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a supplemental scheme booklet for its acquisition of Australian Strategic Materials Limited (ASM). The filing references a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of VAC from Ara Partners and a conditional $725 million financing commitment from the Department of War Office of Strategic Capital. The deal is structured under a Scheme Implementation Deed dated January 21, 2026, as amended. No specific price per share or premium is stated. The supplemental booklet provides further information to ASM shareholders and option holders. Monitor shareholder vote and regulatory approvals for the scheme.
